topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Got a call from a teacher today. She’s got a box on her desk from a name from her past. Wrapped up in old newspaper, tied with faded string. The kind of thing that could hold anything or nothing at all. Could be a peace offering, or a piece of the past she thought she’d put away for good. I told her to take her time with this one. Think about what that box represents, who it might be from, and why it's showing up now. Sometimes, the past has a funny way of sneaking up on you, but it’s how you handle it that counts.
